''See also: [[Angeline Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Angeline is a character who communicates through various methods, including speaking aloud and sending messages. She provides commentary on situations, often offering warnings, observations, or opinions on the honesty and actions of others. Her interactions range from being blunt and grim to appearing loftily or even playful. In certain instances, she has been observed physically assisting others, such as carrying an injured individual on her back.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Angeline is a doll featuring straight blond hair. She wears a black dress and is carried by [[Kai]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|She possesses experience dealing with liars and has the capacity to work through problems alongside the The Wanderer{{!}}Wanderer. She also provides commentary regarding Denner Weeks{{!}}Denner.}}

{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Angeline is currently with [[Simon]] and maintains communication with him.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c7">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 7</ref> She is a doll featuring straight blond hair and wearing a black dress, appearing as she is carried by [[Kai]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 9</ref> As a doll that communicates with [[Simon]], she does so within the depths of his mind.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9" /> After commenting on Denner Weeks{{!}}Denner, she sent a message to [[Simon]] warning him to be prepared to run.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 13</ref> Additionally, she possesses experience dealing with liars.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13" />}}
